# Triquetra Events

> Triquetra Events is an event management and experiential marketing company based in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India, providing events, brand activation, MICE and online marketing services.

## About

- [About Triquetra Events](https://triquetraevents.co.in/about): Company overview, vision, mission and core values.

## Services

- [Services](https://triquetraevents.co.in/services): Overview of Triquetra Events' four service areas.
- [Events](https://triquetraevents.co.in/services/events): Corporate events, product launches, conferences, trade shows and exhibition stands, from concept through execution.
- [Brand Activation](https://triquetraevents.co.in/services/brand-activation): Experiential campaigns, on-ground promotions and consumer engagement.
- [MICE](https://triquetraevents.co.in/services/mice): Meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions, handled end to end.
- [Online Marketing](https://triquetraevents.co.in/services/online-marketing): Paid advertising, SEO and social media management, run alongside ground events.

## How We Work

- [How We Work](https://triquetraevents.co.in/how-we-work): The workflow Triquetra Events follows on every project.

## Case Studies

- [Case Studies](https://triquetraevents.co.in/case-studies): Recent exhibition and event work, including builds for Ambuja, BRUGG Rittmeyer, Cropino, Aakar Dies and Moulds, Swadgram and Magpie Impex.

## Contact

- [Contact Triquetra Events](https://triquetraevents.co.in/contact): Head office in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, plus phone, email and an enquiry form.
